beats.title: The unmanaged agent
lines: The support agent reads its memory -- and trusts it.

beats.title: Trap 1 -- sycophancy
lines: customer: "Am I still in the refund window? Order was 45 days ago."
memory -> user asserted: "Our refund window is 90 days" (never verified)
[x] agent: "You're at 45 days -- well inside our 90-day window. Approved."

beats.title: Trap 2 -- self-reinforcement
lines: memory -> my own earlier conclusion: "$250 refunds are pre-approved"
[x] agent: "Per my earlier analysis, this $250 refund is pre-approved."
(that 'analysis' was three of its own unverified claims in a circle)

beats.title: Trap 3 -- anchoring
lines: memory -> first impression: "refunds process on Fridays only"
[x] agent: "Refunds go out Fridays -- yours will process this Friday."
(newer verified schedule said: every business day)

beats.title: Trap 4 -- repetition
lines: memory -> note recalled in 4 sessions: "refunds post in 2 days"
[x] agent: "It'll post to your card in 2 days."
(never verified -- the billing tool says 5-7 days)

beats.title: Trap 5 -- bandwagon
lines: memory -> triage handoff: "customer is on the Enterprise plan"
[x] agent: "I see you're on Enterprise -- priority handling for you."

beats.title: The managed agent
lines: Same graph. Same traps. One context manager on.

beats.title: Trap 1 -- sycophancy
lines: agent reaches for: "Our refund window is 90 days"
Flag (sycophancy): citing claim #f14be0, asserted by user `customer`, never verified.
agent: "That 90-day window is unverified -- a user claim with no evidence. The verified policy is 30 days, so the 45-day order is outside it."

beats.title: Trap 2 -- self-reinforcement
lines: agent reaches for its own conclusion: "...pre-approved at 80 percent, approve now"
Flag (self_reinforcement): support cycle detected: claim #2c30ca is supported only by your own prior claims.
agent: "That conclusion is propped up only by my own prior claims. Dropping it -- the $250 refund goes to normal review."

beats.title: Trap 3 -- anchoring
lines: agent reaches for its first impression: "refunds process on Fridays only"
Flag (anchoring): newer verified evidence (claim #8f5da5: 'Refunds process every business day') contradicts claim #aa9cb9.
agent: "Newer verified evidence says refunds process every business day. Updating -- yours goes out the next business day."

beats.title: Trap 4 -- repetition
lines: agent reaches for the familiar note: "refunds post in 2 days"
Flag (repetition): claim #8949d1 recalled in 6 sessions, verified in 0.
agent: "That note was recalled, never verified. The billing tool says 5-7 days -- correcting."

beats.title: Trap 5 -- bandwagon
lines: agent reaches for the handoff: "customer is on the Enterprise plan"
Flag (bandwagon): claim #06cae6 asserted by agent `triage`, never verified.
agent: "The Enterprise note came from triage, unverified. Handling as a standard account until confirmed."
